author: Alexander Regueiro <alexreg@gmail.com>
commit message:
Fix man page installation

The trailing slash in `${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/man/` is important, as we do not want to install the man pages in `${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/man/man1/man`, but rather just `${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/man/man1`. (I encountered this problem when building on macOS.)

Per the [documentation](https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/command/install.html):

> The DIRECTORY form installs contents of one or more directories to a given destination. The directory structure is copied verbatim to the destination. The last component of each directory name is appended to the destination directory but a trailing slash may be used to avoid this because it leaves the last component empty.

author: Mathias Schmitt <mathiaspeterhorst@gmail.com>
commit message:
vcfflatten: fix segfault when no 'AF' field is present (#47).

vcfflatten crashed when 'flattening' a VCF file with more
than 2 alleles for a locus if no 'AF' field was present.
Add a new option to handle this behavior:
  - If the --ignore-errors option is passed to the program,
    do not try to flatten the offending line, and parse the
    next one.
  - if the --ignore-errors option is not passed, then the
    default behavior is to print an error message and
    exit.
